item.title: BLUE EXORCIST Manga Is Entering A 4 Month Hiatus Status As Creator Prepares For Final Chapter
item.description: Blue Exorcist, manga by Kazue Kato goes on hiatus starting March 4th, 2026. Creator is gearing up for its final chapter, the manga should be resuming in July.

item.title: WELCOME TO DEMON SCHOOL! IRUMA-KUN Spinoff IRUMAFIA EDITION Is Getting An Anime Next Year
item.description: NHK has announced a TV anime adaptation is coming for Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun: IruMafia Edition spinoff manga, the anime is set to be premiering next year.

item.title: MY UNIQUE SKILL MAKES ME OP EVEN AT LEVEL 1 Manga Goes On Hiatus Due To Artist Health Concerns
item.description: Kodansha's Monthly Shonen Sirius announces hiatus status for My Unique Skill Makes Me OP Even at Level 1 manga series due to artist Mawata's health issues. The return date is TBA.

item.title: ROOSTER FIGHTER Anime English Dub Trailer Confirms Premiere Date And Time
item.description: Viz Media and Adult Swim have dropped an English dub trailer for the Rooster Fighter anime. The anime is set to debut on Toonami March 14th this year.

item.title: Hanashi Media Bolsters Catalog With 11 New Light Novel Licenses For Fans Of All Genres
item.description: Hanashi Media licenses 11 light novels for English and Spanish digital release, headlined by GATE: Thus the JSDF Fought There!, A Journey Through Another World anime tie-in, and Reincarnated Onmyoji.

item.title: THOUGH I AM AN INEPT VILLAINESS Anime Premiere Pushed To July 2026 Due To Production Delays
item.description: The TV anime adaptation of Though I Am an Inept Villainess has been delayed from it's April 2026 premiere due to production issues.

item.title: DIGIMON STORY: TIME STRANGER Is Heading To Nintendo Switch And Switch 2 This Summer
item.description: Bandai Namco has announced that their latest hit game Digimon Story: Time Stranger will be landing on Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 consoles this summer.

item.title: MISTRESS KANAN IS DEVILISHLY EASY Manga Takes Short Break, Returns Later This Month
item.description: Nonco's Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy manga is taking a short pause in Weekly Shōnen Magazine's 10th issue, resuming later this month. The anime adaptation premieres in a few months.

item.title: IS IT WRONG TO TRY TO PICK UP GIRLS IN A DUNGEON? Anime Season 6 Has Been Announced
item.description: DanMachi Season 6 has been officially announced at the series' 10th anniversary event on February 7th, 2026. There is no release date, however, fans got their first look in a new teaser trailer.

item.title: RENT-A-GIRLFRIEND Anime Season 5 Teaser Video Dropped And Theme Songs Revealed
item.description: Rent-A-Girlfriend's Season 5 teaser trailer has dropped, along with news of Sora Amamiya's "Non Scenario Etude" opening and NAKIGOTO's "204-gōshitsu" ending. The 5th season arrives later this year.
